== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Maraschino Cherry|maraschino cherries]], drained
* ½ cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] zest, finely [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]]
* ½ cup dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ¼ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]

== Procedure ==
#Sprinkle cherries with sugar and spices. Set aside.
#Melt butter in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat. Add cherries and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until slightly browned, 4–5 minutes.
#Combine rum and orange zest. Pour over cherries and carefully ignite with a firestick. Shake pan until flames die.
#Serve warm with some [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]].
